    The ray category of a distributive algebra #

    For split basic data of a finite-dimensional algebra B with distributive ideal lattice over an infinite field, the ported BGRS theory gives the distributive hom structure of the category of indecomposable projectives, and the BGRS ray category satisfies the finite-ray-category axioms (SplitBasicData.isFiniteRayCategory; Gabriel–Roiter 13.4). The input is that the ideal lattice is finite (finite_twoSidedIdeal_of_isDistribIdeals).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.rpow_eq_pow {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u_2, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms C] {x : C} (e : CategoryTheory.End x) (n : ℕ) :
    rpow (have this := e; this) n = have this := e ^ n; this

    IsRayCategory C

    A finite ray category in the sense of the ported theory satisfies our axioms.
